CampfireDescription.en: Temporary night shelter. Weapon hits repair it to keep it burning.
CampfireDescription.chi: 临时夜间庇护，攻击修复以维持篝火。

ShelterDescription.en: Establish a new square base outside existing territory. It counts only after construction completes.
ShelterDescription.chi: 在现有基地外开辟方形基地，施工完成后才计入存活基地。

ConstructionComplete.en: Construction complete. The building is now active.

ConstructionIncomplete.en: Under construction: hit with your weapon until full durability. Upgrades become available after completion.
ConstructionIncomplete.chi: 施工中：用武器攻击建造至满耐久，完工后才能启用和升级。

HUDConstruction.chi:
{1} | 建造进度 {2}/{3}
攻击继续建造

BuildIndependentPlacement.en: Independent placement outside base territory is supported.
BuildIndependentPlacement.chi: 支持在基地建造区外独立放置。

ShelterBaseLimit.en: Player base limit reached ({1}). Destroyed base IDs remain reserved until the next campaign.
ShelterBaseLimit.chi: 自建基地数量已达上限（{1}），已毁基地名额保留至新战役。

ShelterOutsideExistingBase.en: Place the shelter outside existing base safety and construction areas.
ShelterOutsideExistingBase.chi: 请在现有基地安全区和建造区外放置庇护所。
